title: Wayfare Pass Membership Terms — Changing Plans
content:
# Changing plans (Wayfare Pass)

## Terms in force

1. A plan change is the member's own decision and is allowed only on an active Wayfare Pass (rider membership) membership, at most the plan's limit of plan changes per billing period. The membership's status and its current period on record decide.
2. A downgrade (a plan listed among the current plan's move-down plans) takes effect at the next renewal and is charged at the new plan's fee then; a move to a plan in neither the move-up list nor the move-down list is not allowed.
3. Moving to or from the Student plan follows the same lists; moving onto the Student plan also requires current student verification.
4. A membership taken out through a card partner offer can change plan only by ending the partner membership and enrolling again.

## Retired term

> An upgrade (a plan listed among the current plan's move-up plans) took effect on the day it was made: a new period of the new plan started that day and the fee collected was the new plan's membership fee less the unused value of the current period, booked as a plan change proration charge. The unused value was the current plan's membership fee multiplied by the days of the period from the change date through the period's last day, both included, divided by the days in the period, rounded half up to the cent; the charge was then rounded half up to the cent.

This term is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded.

## Decision table under the terms in force

| Situation | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Membership not active (for example past due, paused or pending cancellation) | No plan change |
| A plan change already made in the current billing period, at a limit of 1 | No further plan change in that period |
| Target plan in neither list of the current plan | Not allowed |
| Target plan in the move-down list | Takes effect at the next renewal, charged at the new plan's fee then |
| Target plan is Wayfare Pass Student and verification is not current | Not allowed |
| Membership from a card partner offer | Only by ending the partner membership and enrolling again |

## Hypothetical cases

- An active Wayfare Pass Annual member moves down to Wayfare Pass Monthly: the change takes effect at the next renewal, charged at the Monthly fee then.
- A Wayfare Pass Plus Annual member asks to move to Wayfare Pass Student: Student is in neither list of Plus Annual, so the move is not allowed.

superseded_clauses: An upgrade (a plan listed in upgrade_targets) takes effect on the day it is made: a new period of the new plan starts that day and the fee collected is the new plan's membership_fee less the unused value of the current period (pass_msr_unused_period_value), booked as charge_reason plan_change_proration.
